decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the demolition of first floor extension and erection of a new first floor extension to rear, retention of a roof terrace, internal refurbishments and landscaping of rear garden, as shown on drawing numbers 0227(PL)02 (Rev A), 0227(PL)03 (Rev A), 0227(PL)07 (Rev A) & 0227(PL)08 (Rev A), received 07 November 2006; 0227(PL)01 (Rev B) & 0227(PL)05 (Rev B), received 18 January 2007; and 0227(PL)04 (Rev C), & 0227(PL)06 (Rev C), received 09 February 2007, by reason of its design, position and appearance, would be compatible with the scale and form of the original building, would maintain the character and appearance of the Listed Building and preserve the appearance and character of Bedford Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, ENV.B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Demolition of first floor extension and erection of a new first floor extension to rear, retention of a roof terrace, internal refurbishments and landscaping of rear garden
